entries.who_uses: Everyone early on: identifies an item. Once the Hooded One is in town he identifies for free.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. The free Hooded One identify is from boostmatch; u4n only says NPCs identify for free later. Pickup bucket from poe.ninja/poe2scout prices on 2026-09-29 (~0.02–0.06 Ex).

entries.who_uses: No direct use: 10 shards combine into one Orb of Transmutation.

claim.note: Prices conflict: poe2scout listed 20 Ex, which cannot be right for a tenth of a ~1 Ex orb; poe.ninja listed ~0.2 Ex. We follow poe.ninja.

entries.who_uses: Everyone: makes a white item magic with 1 mod — cheap levelling gear and waystone upgrades.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. ~1 Ex each on both price sites (2026-09-29): cheap alone, worth keeping a stack.

entries.who_uses: Crafters add a second mod to a magic item that has only one.

claim.note: Magic items hold at most 2 mods (poe2db). ~2.4–2.6 Ex on 2026-09-29, just over our 2 Ex 'always' line.

entries.who_uses: Crafters turn a magic item rare: it keeps its mods and gains one more.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. ~2–3 Ex on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Everyone: turns a white or magic item into a rare with 4 random mods — gear and waystones.

claim.note: poe2db item text: Normal or Magic → Rare with 4 mods (older guides say Normal only). ~3.4–3.8 Ex on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Everyone: the everyday trade currency. Crafters add one mod to a rare with a free slot.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. Both price sites quote in Exalted, so it is the everyday trade unit.

entries.who_uses: Crafters swap one random mod on a rare. Also a mid-value trade currency.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db: removes one random mod and adds one. ~66–69 Ex on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: The main high-value trade currency. Crafters reroll the numbers on a finished item's mods.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. Priced in the hundreds of Exalted on both sites (2026-09-29).

entries.who_uses: Crafters remove one random mod from a magic or rare item.

claim.note: poe2db usage text says 'magic or rare item'. Worth over half a Divine on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Corrupts an item for a gamble (socket, enchant or reroll). The item can't be changed after.

claim.note: poe2db: 'Modifies an item unpredictably and Corrupts it… Corrupted items cannot be modified again'. The outcome list comes from community corruption tables. ~7.5 Ex on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Gamblers: turns a white item into its unique version — or destroys it.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. ~9.7 Ex on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Adds a rune socket to a martial weapon, wand, staff or armour so you can slot runes.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. The price sites land on opposite sides of our 2 Ex line (poe.ninja 1.65 Ex, poe2scout 2.7 Ex); we follow poe.ninja.

entries.who_uses: Adds quality to a skill gem. It sells well, so always grab it.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. ~15 Ex on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Adds quality to armour for more defence.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. Surprisingly valuable in 0.5.5: ~9 Ex on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Adds quality to a martial weapon for more damage.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. ~2.7–3.3 Ex on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Adds quality to a flask. Cheap, but it sells.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. ~3–5.7 Ex on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Crafters lock one random mod on a rare with 4+ mods so later crafting can't remove it.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. Several Divine each on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Endgame crafters add a mod of level 50+ to a rare. Only drops in level 79+ areas.

claim.note: poe2db: Minimum Modifier Level 50, Drop Level 79. ~3 Div on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Copies a non-unique item. The rarest currency; mirrored copies can't be changed.

claim.note: Effect from poe2db. Thousands of Divine on 2026-09-29.

entries.who_uses: Crafters: while it is active, your next Chaos Orb removes the lowest-level mod.

claim.note: Item text and drop level 75 from poe2db. Price from poe.ninja only (~12 Div on 2026-09-29). 'Bought with Ritual tribute' seen in search results only.

entries.who_uses: Crafters: your next Orb of Annulment removes only Desecrated mods. Drops from Abyss rares.

claim.note: Item text from poe2db; price from poe.ninja only (~9 Div on 2026-09-29). Drop source per search results: any rare in Abyssal Depths in 0.5.5; in normal maps only Amanamu-faction rares.

entries.who_uses: Crafters turn a magic item rare with a guaranteed maximum Life mod.

claim.note: poe2db: every tier, Lesser included, 'Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding a guaranteed modifier' (older guides say white → magic). Thin market: poe.ninja ~7 Ex vs poe2scout 1 Ex, so graded 'stack' to be safe.
